record.evidence_quote: The ionic conductivity of Bi5NbO10 solid solutions at 700 oC is 2.86 (Ω·m)-1 which is in same order of magnitude for Y2O3-stabilized ZrO2 ceramics at same temperature.
record.notes: Mobile species is oxygen ion (O2-), which is not Li/Na; mobile_ion set to 'other'. Material is a Bi5NbO10 solid solution with no dopant listed. Sintering is only given as a range (800-900 °C) so left null. Activation energy 0.94 ± 0.02 eV is the dc Arrhenius value from the same paper (Edc), attached here as the closest reported value for this conductivity. The unit (Ω·m)-1 is as written; the value is unusually high for an oxide at 700 °C and the paper does not give more detail, so it is reported as written.
